steps.text: Speak to Awusah the Mayor in Nardah.
choices: I am an adventurer in search of quests.
Any idea how you got this curse?
Ok I will have a look around and see what I can do.

steps.text: Speak to Ghaslor the Elder, just north of Awusah.
choices: I am trying to find out the cause of this town's curse.

steps.text: Open and search the cupboard in the north-west corner of the house that is north of the fountain.
Use the needle and thread on the torn robes (both top and bottom).
Use the needle and thread on the torn robes (both top and bottom).
Cast the Telekinetic Grab spell on the ancestral key on the table.
Use the rope on the root to enter the cave north-west of Nardah where the river turns into a waterfall.
Equip the Robes of Elidinis and use the ancestral key on the door.
Open the door to the south and fight the White Golem (level-75).  You can only damage the Golem with the stab attack style.
Open the southern door again.
Clear the Water Channel then leave the room.
Open the door to the east and fight the Grey Golem (level-75).  You can only damage the Golem with the slash attack style.
Open the eastern door again.
Clear the Water Channel then leave the room.
Open the door to the north-east and fight the Black Golem (level-75).  You can only damage the Golem with the crush attack style.
Open the north-eastern door again.
Clear the Water Channel by shooting the target then leave the room.
Open the door to the north near the lake.
Talk to the Water Spirits on the north side of the lake.
choices: I come as an emissary from the people of Nardah.
Is there anything they can do to get their fountain working again?

steps.text: Return to Nardah and speak to Awusah the Mayor.
Take the shoes near the doorway then leave Awusah's house.
Leave Awusah's home.
Use a knife on the shoes to cut out the sole.
Enter the crevice to the west of Nardah.
Talk to the Genie in the Crevice.
choices: I'm after a statue that was thrown down here.
Maybe I can make a deal for it?
Ok I agree to the deal.

steps.text: Talk to the Genie again with the sole.
Return to Nardah and use the statuette on the statuette plinth in the northern house.
